purpose: Expose whether a pre-issue SEP forecast record is scientifically interpretable and whether its inputs and provenance passed the frozen validity gates. This is an audit layer, not a new operational forecaster.

record_fields.alert: boolean for VALID/DEGRADED; null for ABSTAIN
record_fields.input_age_seconds: mapping from input/source id to non-negative age in seconds
record_fields.source_hashes: mapping from source id to SHA-256
record_fields.ledger_previous_hash: SHA-256 of previous record, or null only for an explicitly declared genesis record

STALE_INPUT.meaning: At least one required input exceeded its separately frozen source-specific age limit.

REQUIRED_FEED_ABSENT.meaning: A required forecast-time feed was absent.

AMBIGUOUS_PROTON_CHANNEL.meaning: The required integral >=10 MeV proton quantity could not be identified unambiguously.

STRUCTURAL_UNAVAILABILITY.meaning: A required quantity was not authoritatively available in the source/instrument regime; it must not be reconstructed and relabelled as an observation.

EXCESSIVE_TRANSIENT_LOSS.meaning: Transient loss exceeded the separately frozen, validated recovery envelope.

CAUSAL_AVAILABILITY_RECEIPT_FAILED.meaning: A required input failed the issue-time causal-availability receipt gate.

LEDGER_INTEGRITY_FAILURE.meaning: The append-only prediction ledger or previous-record link failed integrity verification.

FUTURE_OBSERVATION.meaning: At least one supplied predictor observation occurred after the forecast issue time.

PROVENANCE_UNCERTAIN.meaning: Required source identity, hash, routing or provenance could not be verified.

TRANSIENT_FORWARD_FILL_APPLIED.meaning: A short transient gap was recovered causally within a separately frozen source-specific limit; the recovered value is not relabelled as an observation.

precedence: If any ABSTAIN-severity reason is present, validity_state=ABSTAIN and alert=null.
Else if any DEGRADED-severity reason is present, validity_state=DEGRADED and the pre-existing candidate alert may be exposed.
Else validity_state=VALID and the pre-existing candidate alert may be exposed.

missingness_dependency.rule: Do not infer an operational recovery threshold from synthetic masking percentages alone. Source-specific freshness and recovery limits must be separately frozen before prospective execution.
missingness_dependency.historical_working_evidence: The two-week pilot plan reports that causal forward-fill preserved probabilities reasonably under 5-20% random transient loss and degraded materially at 40% loss. Treat this as synthetic research evidence, not blanket operational certification.

promotion_requires: preregistered comparison on hidden real magnetic maps
better reconstruction performance than persistence on the frozen comparison
preservation of downstream causal new-onset forecasting utility

claim_boundary: A VALID or DEGRADED record means only that the frozen validity interface passed its declared pre-issue checks. It does not establish forecast skill, operational certification, company benefit, economic savings or prospective confirmation.
